name: ReactiveAdversarialResilienceGuardian
description: A proactive security system that combines reactive vulnerability scanning with adversarial robustness monitoring to identify and mitigate threats, even under attack. It not only scans for known vulnerabilities but also observes system behavior for anomalies indicating adversarial manipulation or evasion. When suspicious activity is detected, it reasons about potential attack vectors and dynamically adjusts scanning strategies and defensive responses.
